_meta.fixtures: 3 synthetic clusters, 8 memories, 8 unique facts, cluster threshold 0.85
_meta.finding: The shipping default content_strategy (keep_higher_recall) loses 38% of unique facts when it merges a cluster: the survivor's text is kept verbatim and every other member's distinguishing detail is soft-deleted with it. mmr_union and concat retain 100% at the same surviving-memory count, so the loss is a choice of default, not a cost of consolidating.
